description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Complete Weather Stripping / Rubber Replacement Kit.
Does your Samurai clatter like a bag of dimes in a dryer? Then make it sound as quiet as the day it rolled off the lot with this 21 piece OEM Weather Strip & Seal Kit.
It’ll quiet down and seals the following areas:
Passengers Side Door Opening
Drivers Side Door Opening
Tailgate Opening
Drivers Side Glass
Passenger Side Glass
Drivers Side Door Rail
Passenger Side Door Rail
Floor Drain Plugs
These parts are made to fit and require no cutting or modifications and will not only quieten the noise, it will also keep your Sammy warmer in the winter.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Drivers Door Opening Weather Strip
Qty 1 – Drivers Door Glass Run
Qty 1 – Drivers Door Glass Scrape – Inner
Qty 1 – Drivers Door Glass Scrape – Outer
Qty 1 – Drivers Door – Interior Cavity Seal
Qty 1 – Passengers Door Opening Weather Strip
Qty 1 – Passengers Door Glass Run
Qty 1 – Passengers Door Glass Scrape – Inner
Qty 1 – Passengers Door Glass Scrape – Outer
Qty 1 – Passengers Door – Interior Cavity Seal
Qty 1 – Tailgate Opening Weather Strip
Plus
Qty 1 – Drivers Side Door Rail Seal
Qty 1 – Passengers Side Door Rail Seal
Qty 6 – Large Floor Drain Plugs
Qty 2 – Small Floor Drain Plugs
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
